name: Shatterpoint Ammunition (Greater)
text:
Ammunition any

Activate 1 (manipulate)

---
Crafted out of spite to counter a caster's animated objects, shatterpoint ammunition hums quiet songs of destruction. When activated shatterpoint ammunition hits a target, the damage the ammunition deals ignores the target's Hardness if it's 8 or lower. In addition, the target takes 2d8 persistent,sonic damage from the vibrations.
